mapper.insert: insert into platform_access_token( id, token_hash, subject_type, subject_id, display_name, status, created_by, created_at, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at ) values ( #{id}, #{tokenHash}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{displayName}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, null, null )
